scope: Offline corpus model experiment; no default-generator or historical-scorer changes and no human-wordlikeness claim

split.bucket: first unsigned big-endian 32 bits of SHA256 of JSON [seed, spelling], modulo 10000
split.grouping: all identical normalized spellings together; morphological family grouping unavailable

segmentation.initialOnsets: training entries only, including empty onset
segmentation.allSplits: same frozen inferred segmentation; not observed CMU syllable labels

models.baseline: class-only counts smoothed toward normalized open-support phone/length base
models.candidate: edge-and-stress-and-class counts -> stress-and-class -> class -> normalized open-support base
models.base: Dirichlet(0.5) categorical phones; onset/coda geometric length with Beta(1,1) stop estimate; rime vowel distribution restricted and normalized within declared class
models.selection: choose smallest development negative log likelihood separately per model; tie choose smaller alpha; no held-out tuning

endpoints.primary: held-out mean negative log likelihood per selected spelling, using same inferred constituent observations for both models
endpoints.tail: unseen-event mass and probability positivity; retain all events, no floor/clipping
endpoints.diversity: observed support, concentration and novel-event mass with scope explicit; no generator diversity claim without generation experiment

verification: exact source and selected-entry identities; split disjointness and coverage
normalized finite positive conditional probabilities and deterministic builds
training-only segmentation/count fitting; development-only alpha choice
independent reconstruction of source selection, split, segmentation and every integer table
unchanged historical scorer artifacts and generator source; tests and source typechecking
candidateRuntime: No runtime activation in this offline model PR; any later weighted-generator use requires independent output and RNG evidence
